WHAT'S REAL vs. DUMMY

REAL, from helloverify.com: logo (recoloured for light mode), Y Combinator badge, 20M+ checks since 2018, 2,000+ clients, 120+ countries, 33+ checks, 6 offices, Ministry of Manpower (Singapore), governments list (India, KSA, UAE, Singapore, European), certifications (ISO 27001, GDPR, PBSA, NSR), all footer links, form fields and consent text. Real times: Age 15 min, Driving licence 30 min, Digital employment 60 min, blue-collar & consumer packages 30 min.

DUMMY (replace): every other time on the checks catalogue, receipts and cards; the sample candidate A. Ramesh and all timestamps; the WhatsApp chat; the customer story quote and its two numbers; [₹ price] on the driver plans.

NOTE: the original site shows no client logos — only YC and Ministry of Manpower. Send logos if you have permission to use them and I'll add a strip.

BRAND: the logo's swoosh is red (#EC2E21). Red reads as 'error' in a verification product, so the page keeps red only in the logo and uses green for 'verified'. Say if you want red as the accent instead.

PHOTOGRAPHY BRIEF

Every toned block is a photo slot. Warm, candid, real people at work in real places: a rider in Bengaluru traffic, a nurse in an Abu Dhabi ward, a supplier on a Cairo factory floor, a family at a Gurugram doorway, a ministry hall. Natural light, no stock handshakes, no laptops-with-graphs.

The contact-section photo should be the single strongest image — it carries the closing line.
